ignoreCommand: base=''; for candidate in "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD^ HEAD~1; do if [ -n "$candidate" ] && git rev-parse --verify --quiet "$candidate^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then base="$candidate"; break; fi; done; [ -n "$base" ] || exit 1; if git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD -- . ':!*.md' ':!docs/**' ':!.github/**' ':!.agents/**' ':!.claude/**' && git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD -- public/; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
